svg.title: for invariant g. For a generator of positive length l, its coefficient after this projection is the averaged length-k −l part of the old coefficient; it has length strictly smaller than k. Induction on length expresses it as products of the same generators. Constants are empty products. Thus every invariant polynomial homogeneous of length k on this shelf lies in the span of products Q i Vi, with each Vi invariant of engineering weight at most r, homogeneous of length ki, and P i ki = k. This is the finite hosting bound; the number of factors is unrestricted.
